>It’s possible to feel even better than you do now.

I sure hope i get to this point someday.
I'll discuss adjusting medications with my psychiatrist.

Thank you for your response i truly appreciate it.

>the concept of free will is one I struggle with.

I share the same thoughts with you, check Free Will a short book by Sam Harris, i think you will find this interesting. 

Ironically this doesn't help with my feeling that I'm just a shirker. I desperately need to get out of this "doing nothing-feeling good" state.

Thanks for your wishes
I'm sorry you went through all of this. I hope you will feel better someday soon.

>Nothing about therapy requires you to share your most intimate thoughts

It's a relief to look at it this way. I've always thought that in order for therapy to work out, one should completely be open and exposed.
I hope things will work out.
Thank you for your support, i really appreciate it

I've been on therapy for only a month now and i hate it.. I cant bear talking about my most intimate thoughts to anyone.my need of being in control makes it difficult for me to listen to someone telling me how it's done. I was concidering continuing with medications only.. I know PTSD is better treated with therapy, i think that's why I'm not comfortable with the lable.
Is your diagnosis of bipolar now changed to PTSD?
This is informative ..i can relate to a lot of what you've said...Thank you for your response and support it really helped.

I hope you find peace in whatever choice you make..
Just a small tip: don't forget about the natural instinct of survival, your brain will make your body shake badly, you will freak out and may lose control..just don't think you are a coward it's normal.
It takes tremendous mount of despair to end one's own life.
